# Key facts
- **H1:** Sewer Pipe Lining: The Complete Guide for Phoenix Property Owners and Managers. **Title:** Sewer Pipe Lining: Complete Phoenix Guide. Slug /sewer-pipe-lining.
- Supporting keywords: trenchless pipe repair, epoxy pipe lining, pipe lining cost, commercial sewer line repair, commercial plumbing phoenix, trenchless sewer repair phoenix, hoa sewer line repair, cipp lining (context only, /what-is-cipp/ owns it).
- Includes an internal link plan (service pages, sibling posts, Phoenix page, contact), the HTML body, image alts, optional FAQPage schema, external sources and a pre-delivery checklist with [VERIFY] items for Kim.

# Status
No publish record in this folder; not in the July live blog inventory. It conflicts with later rules: "pipe lining" as a focus noun, commercial scope unconfirmed by Scott, "Pipeliners USA" naming, and it targets "trenchless pipe repair" which the ad service page owns.
